title: Fishing license requirements
question: Do I need a license to fish in Poland?
short_answer: Yes. Fishing requires a state fishing license and often a club permit.
conditions: State fishing license (karta wędkarska) required — obtained from Polish Angling Association (PZW)
Additional zezwolenie (permit) needed for specific waters managed by angling clubs
Season tickets may be required for certain lakes and rivers
Catch limits and size restrictions apply to specific species
Closed seasons (ochrona) exist for many fish species (e.g. pike, perch)
exceptions: Children under 14 may fish without a license when accompanied by a licensed adult
Some tourist areas offer day licenses for visitors
penalties: Fine: 500–5000 PLN for fishing without a license
Fine: up to 5000 PLN for fishing in a protected zone
